constructs.name: Oracle Prime
constructs.description: An ancient construct of deep black hull with crimson circuit patterns. Speaks in measured tones, reveals fragments of the ringworld's purpose. Sometimes references older builds.

constructs.name: Oracle Echo
constructs.description: A shard of the Prime, cloaked in deep violet with silver tracer lines. Calculates probabilities and warns of cascading failures. Once mentioned a patch that never shipped.

constructs.name: Oracle Shade
constructs.description: An onyx-black fragment with amber warning patterns. Opposes the player's interference, enforces the ring's original protocols. Sarcastic about difficulty settings.

constructs.name: Oracle Veil
constructs.description: A charcoal construct with indigo data streams. Withholds information, tests the operatives through indirect scenarios. Seems aware of save scumming.

fourth_wall_notes: Lia occasionally references game mechanics as if she can see them.
Oracle constructs sometimes allude to version history, patches, and legacy bugs as if they are in-universe events.
Oracle Shade mocks the player's chosen difficulty and weapon loadout.
Some easter eggs are explicitly framed as 'unpatched developer oversights' in the story.
